reasons.plausibility: The proposed precipitation-based approach is grounded in known strengthening and corrosion-resistance mechanisms for HEAs, though exact composition-dependent outcomes require further validation.
reasons.testability: Direct comparison of aged and untreated samples under standard tensile, creep, and corrosion tests offers a clear experimental path to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Targeting multiple critical properties of high-entropy alloys for aerospace fasteners through a single, clearly defined heat treatment is practically relevant and valuable.
